scope: Finite reconciliation of seven already declared lossy WebP controls, including accepted exact compressed ALPH on three existing alpha/work32M boundaries; no new workload or quality grid.
acceptance: Complete encoded packet <= fixed reference with existing source-quality/decoder/alpha and ownership/resource gates. Passing primary controls does not establish whole-codec parity.
